versions.revisionNotes: EASI v2: Alternative 2 (the same 34 curves, bands, weights and evidence) with the corrected cross-section quality checks (K2b): the four DEM cross-section ratings (bank height ratio, entrenchment ratio, bank-instability susceptibility, channel adjustment) are withheld where the sections are unreliable, and a bank height ratio at the cap on resolved sections rates as severe incision. Every rating kept is the v1 rating. Adopted by the study 2026-09-28-dem-geometry-quality-alternatives (owner decisions D15 and D20, 2026-09-28).
